references.label: High-voltage battery pack, light-duty vehicles
references.use: Reference only for a defined incremental battery-capacity scenario at comparable scale and specification.
references.limit: Modeled US market cost, not a BMW quote. Battery changes also require pack design, thermal, BMS, validation and integration costs.

references.label: 100 kW traction motor and inverter reference
references.locator: Electric Drive Technical Team Roadmap, Current Technical Target Status
references.use: Historical scale reference for a specified 100 kW motor plus inverter system.
references.limit: 2022 estimate derived from older public teardown/scaling, not a current BMW supplier quote. Excludes drivetrain integration, cooling, wiring, testing and tooling.

references.label: US mechanical engineer mean wage
references.locator: May 2025 national OEWS Table 1, Mechanical engineers
references.use: Reference when checking an engineering labor assumption.
references.limit: National wage, not BMW loaded engineering rate; excludes benefits, overhead, supplier margins and program geography.

references.label: US electrical engineer mean wage
references.locator: May 2025 national OEWS Table 1, Electrical engineers
references.use: Reference when checking an engineering labor assumption.
references.limit: National wage, not BMW loaded engineering rate; excludes benefits, overhead, supplier margins and program geography.

references.label: US software developer mean wage
references.locator: May 2025 national OEWS Table 1, Software developers
references.use: Reference when checking a software engineering labor assumption.
references.limit: National wage, not BMW loaded engineering rate; excludes benefits, overhead, supplier margins and program geography.

references.label: Modeled electric traction motor plus inverter, per peak kW
references.unit: USD per kW peak motor power
references.use: Scale a defined peak-power motor-plus-inverter case, then add omitted vehicle integration and program costs.
references.limit: Draft regulatory analysis, 2024-dollar adjustment of older public teardown/model inputs. Direct manufacturing cost, not current BMW procurement price; overlaps the DOE traction-drive reference, so do not add both.

references.label: Modeled vehicle on-board charger, per rated kW
references.use: Reference for a specified in-vehicle charger power rating only.
references.limit: Draft regulatory model based on older teardown data, adjusted to 2024 dollars. Assumes 7 kW BEV or 2 kW PHEV; excludes installation, integration, controls and validation. Not an external charging-station price.

references.label: Modeled vehicle DC/DC converter, per rated kW
references.use: Reference for a specified in-vehicle converter rated power; study assumes 2 kW.
references.limit: Draft regulatory model based on older teardown data, adjusted to 2024 dollars. Excludes integration, controls and validation; not a BMW quote.

references.label: Modeled high-voltage cables, fixed 360 V system
references.use: Historical scale check only for a comparable 360 V system.
references.limit: Draft regulatory model updates a 2011 hybrid teardown to 2024 dollars; not suitable for a different voltage, architecture, cable length or incremental wiring change without engineering review.

references.label: German manufacturing employer labor cost
references.locator: 2025 labour costs per hour worked, Manufacturing, Germany
references.use: Reference when checking a Germany-based manufacturing or assembly labor input.
references.limit: Manufacturing-sector average across employers, not BMW plant, job grade, supplier rate or an incremental vehicle assembly quote.

references.label: US automotive service technician mean wage
references.locator: May 2025 national OEWS Table 1, Automotive service technicians and mechanics
references.use: Reference for reviewing a service labor assumption.
references.limit: National employee wage, not a dealer labor charge, warranty reimbursement rate or loaded employer cost.

references.label: Public Level 2 charging equipment
references.use: Only for a US public charging-site project, separate from vehicle feature cost.
references.limit: Source page does not specify a common price year. Site electricity, networking, installation, permits and operations are separate. Never use as an on-board charger cost.

references.label: Public DC fast charging equipment
references.use: Only for a US public charging-site project, separate from vehicle feature cost.
references.limit: Source page does not specify a common price year. Power rating drives cost; grid work, installation and operations are separate. Never use as a vehicle cost.

references.label: Public or workplace Level 2 charger installation
references.use: Only for a US public or workplace charging-site project, separate from equipment and vehicle cost.
references.limit: Source page does not specify a common price year. Site conditions, trenching, grid upgrade, permits and scale can change cost materially.

references.label: Public DC fast charger installation
references.use: Only for a US public charging-site project, separate from equipment and vehicle cost.
references.limit: Source page does not specify a common price year. Power and site count affect cost; grid upgrade, permits and operations may add more.

references.label: Modeled absolute electric power steering technology cost, MY 2025
references.use: Historical scale check for the entire modeled EPS technology only.
references.limit: 2018-dollar regulatory model based on older studies, with learning effects; absolute technology cost rather than incremental cost of a new steering feature. Not suitable for automatic current feature pricing.

references.label: Modeled absolute improved accessory system cost, MY 2025
references.use: Historical scale check for the modeled accessory bundle only.
references.limit: 2018-dollar regulatory model based on older studies. Bundle definition and vehicle architecture determine relevance; not the cost of any individual pump, fan or alternator.

references.label: Modeled absolute low-drag-brake technology cost, MY 2025
references.use: Historical scale check for the modeled low-drag-brake technology only.
references.limit: 2018-dollar regulatory model based on older studies; low-drag brakes were treated as baseline technology in the rulemaking. Not an incremental price for a new braking feature.

references.label: Modeled absolute secondary axle-disconnect technology cost, MY 2025
references.use: Historical scale check for the modeled disconnect technology only.
references.limit: 2018-dollar regulatory model based on older studies; actual architecture, packaging and actuation differ. Not a current BMW axle-system quote.

scope: Public benchmarks for scoped scenarios; never BMW supplier prices or automatic feature estimates.
